summary: The seven audit commands must not assume the local mirror holds collections, redirects, or CMS items; they fall back to scoped API reads and degrade to a shaped empty result with an actionable note when the credential is missing.
reason: Generated sync in this Press version cannot reach `collections`, `redirects`, or an unqualified `items` (each fails with '1 resource(s) failed to sync'; `items` additionally requires WEBFLOW_COLLECTION_ID and covers one collection per run). Without the live fallback, `redirects audit` could never audit anything, `collections completeness` could never detect required-field gaps, and `overview` reported 0 unpublished items while `publish preview` reported the real count on the same mirror. A regen must re-check whether the sync enumeration has grown before reverting these commands to mirror-only reads.
validated_outcome: With no valid credential every audit exits 0 with its own object-shaped JSON and a note naming WEBFLOW_API_TOKEN; shipcheck sample-output probe 7/7, scorecard 94/100.
